answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 46168 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Asma al-Husna Question: (1) "Ar-Rashid" is this name of ALLAH (SWT)? (2) Is this name Ar-Rasid included in Asma-ul-Husna? (3) Is this name one of the 99 names of ALLAH? Answer ID: 46168 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1020/678/L=1434) Yes, “Al-Rasheed” is one among the beautiful names of Allah. It is one of the ninety nine names of Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
